BiblicalUsage: Ilai was one of David's mighty men, an Ahohite. In 1 Chronicles 11:29 Ilai the Ahohite stands in the list of the valiant men who served David, named among the thirty.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a place in that list is honour enough: Ilai the Ahohite is remembered because he stood with David when it counted.
